title: GeneQuantify: Expression & CNV Analysis

author.name: burhanettiny
author.field: Molecular biology: relative gene-expression analysis of real-time qPCR data

provenance.origin: github.com/burhanettiny/GeneQuantify at c0c913fd4a05, personal (personal: "qpcr" "streamlit" in:readme,description archived:false (page 2))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Turn replicate Cq values for control and patient/treatment groups into ΔΔCq (Livak) and Pfaffl fold changes, with outlier screening, reference-gene stability checks, automatic choice of statistical test, multiple-testing correction, plots and CSV/PDF export. Despite 'CNV' in the title, no separate copy-number mode was seen; relative CNV would go through the same ΔΔCq path. Data used in the run: synthetic. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
